How to use this navigator

Source reference tells you where to read. Open the official document and confirm the complete provision, definitions, footnotes and transition rules.

Interpretation explains the idea in plain language. It is educational commentary, not a quotation or legal interpretation.

Calculation implication tells you what changes in a workflow. It is not a production specification or regulatory advice.
